title: Backside
summary: BACK'SIDE, noun [back and side.] The back part of anything; the part behind that which is presented to the face of a spectator. Exodus 3:1. 2. The hind part of an animal. 3. The yard, ground or place

inlines.v: BACK'SIDE, noun [back and side.] The back part of anything; the part behind that which is presented to the face of a spectator. Exodus 3:1. 2. The hind part of an animal. 3. The yard, ground or place behind a house.
